prompt:
Our healthcare patient portal is about to go live and our legal team flagged that we need a formal accessibility compliance audit before launch. The portal has several components — a patient registration form, an appointment booking modal, a medical records table, a navigation menu, and the main dashboard — all sitting under `src/`. 

Please do a thorough accessibility review of the entire codebase and produce a formal audit report saved as a Markdown file named `accessibility-review-YYYY-MM-DD-HHmmss.md` (use the actual current timestamp). We need this report to be comprehensive enough to hand to our compliance team, covering every component that has issues.
